- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~2491-2537 ("Ensure E2E smoke-test labels exist on repo" step) | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The step hard-fails if scripts/label_helpers.sh is missing or ensure_label_exists is undefined, with no fallback.
  WHY: Consumer repos without the bootstrap helper can fail PR creation entirely.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~2589-2667 ("Backstop E2E smoke-test labels on PR after creation" step) | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The backstop uses ensure_label_exists with a warn/skip path, so if PR creation races or 422s the labels can still be absent.
  WHY: If the backstop does nothing, review_autofix can miss the labels and auto-merge the canary anyway.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~3953-3977 (label fetch in "Enable auto-merge on PR") | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The label check is implemented in a way that can miss e2e-smoke-test on PRs with many labels.
  WHY: The intended auto-merge suppression can fail and let an e2e PR merge despite the label being present.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:~858-878 (inject-bait pr_already_closed branch) | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The branch exits non-zero, which propagates a failed job status even though the summary step still reports pr_already_closed.
  WHY: A legitimate early auto-merge race can be reported as a smoke-test failure and block the release gate.

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~2491-2537 ("Ensure E2E smoke-test labels exist on repo" step) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Step hard-fails via `set -euo pipefail` if `scripts/label_helpers.sh` missing or `ensure_label_exists` undefined (no fallback like prior inline helper).
  WHY: Consumer repo without bootstrap fails PR creation entirely (no implement PR made).
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~2589-2667 ("Backstop E2E smoke-test labels on PR after creation" step) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `ensure_label_exists` called with `|| true` warn/skip on failure/missing helper, but PR-create `--label` atomicity assumed primary — backstop noop leaves labels absent if PR-create races 422.
  WHY: `review_autofix.yml` gate misses `force-review`/`e2e-smoke-test`, auto-merges bait-missing canary anyway.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~3953-3977 (label fetch in "Enable auto-merge on PR") | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `--paginate | jq '.[].name' | sort -u | grep -qxF 'e2e-smoke-test'` assumes single-page or perfect flatten; >100 labels paginates beyond `--per_page=100` default, misses label.
  WHY: e2e PR auto-merges despite label present (fails PR intent).
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:~858-878 (inject-bait pr_already_closed branch) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `exit 1` skips downstream phases, but `if: always()` summary still runs — reports `pr_already_closed` but job status=failed propagates to release gate.
  WHY: Legit race (early auto-merge) falsely fails smoke test/release.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
